title: 望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐~Active support of telescope primary mirrors
focus: 薄彎月主鏡的重力變形、模態剛性、軸向與側向支撐、低頻波前感測與力圖監測~Gravity sag of thin meniscus primaries, modal stiffness, axial and lateral support, low-rate wavefront sensing and force-map monitoring
summary: 以 VLT 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄彎月主鏡與 150 支軸向致動器為主軸，理解為什麼薄鏡必須由力分佈定義面形，再把彎曲模態、仰角載重、溫度梯度、30 秒積分的 Shack–Hartmann 感測、查找表與力圖健康監測整合成可驗收的主動光學工程。~Built around the VLT's 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus and its 150 axial actuators, this course shows why a thin mirror's figure must be defined by its force distribution, then integrates bending modes, elevation loads, thermal gradients, 30-second Shack–Hartmann sensing, look-up tables and force-map health monitoring into an acceptable active-optics engineering record.

units.anchor: 8.2 m 薄彎月鏡坯~8.2 m thin meniscus blank
units.title: 薄彎月主鏡的質量、剛性與重力變形~Mass, stiffness and gravity sag of a thin meniscus
units.mechanism: 傳統主鏡以約 1:6 的厚徑比維持剛性，但口徑放大到 8 m 時鏡坯會重達上百噸、熱時間常數長達數天，鏡室與望遠鏡結構都難以承受。VLT 改用直徑 8.2 m、厚 175 mm 的 Zerodur 薄彎月鏡，厚徑比約 1:47、質量約 23 噸；然而板的彎曲剛度 D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) 隨厚度三次方下降，鏡面在自身重量下已無法保持形狀。主動支撐的出發點就是承認這面鏡子是軟的，改由支撐力的分佈來定義面形。~Classical primaries keep their stiffness with a thickness-to-diameter ratio near 1:6, but at 8 m aperture such a blank would weigh well over a hundred tonnes with a thermal time constant of days, burdening both cell and telescope structure. The VLT instead uses an 8.2 m diameter, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus with an aspect ratio near 1:47 and a mass of about 23 tonnes; however the plate bending stiffness D = E·t³/(12(1 − ν²)) falls with the cube of thickness, so the mirror can no longer hold its shape under its own weight. Active support starts by accepting that the mirror is soft and letting the distribution of support forces define its figure.
units.model: Zerodur E = 90.3 GPa、ν = 0.243、ρ = 2530 kg/m³、t = 0.175 m：D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m，自重面載 q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa。若只在外緣簡支，中心撓度 w = (5 + ν)·q·a⁴/(64(1 + ν)·D) ≈ 1.9 mm（a = 4.1 m）；同口徑做成 1.37 m 厚（1:6）只撓 0.031 mm，但質量達 183 噸。改用 150 點支撐，每點分攤約 0.35 m²、跨距約 0.59 m，撓度隨跨距四次方縮小 (0.59/8.2)⁴ ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁵，量級降到數十 nm。~For Zerodur with E = 90.3 GPa, ν = 0.243, ρ = 2530 kg/m³ and t = 0.175 m, D ≈ 4.29×10⁷ N·m and the self-weight pressure is q = ρ·g·t ≈ 4,340 Pa. Simply supported only at the rim, the centre deflection w = (5 + ν)·q·a⁴/(64(1 + ν)·D) ≈ 1.9 mm for a = 4.1 m; the same aperture at 1.37 m thickness (1:6) sags only 0.031 mm but weighs 183 tonnes. With 150 supports each carrying about 0.35 m² over a span near 0.59 m, deflection scales down with the fourth power of span, (0.59/8.2)⁴ ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁵, to the order of tens of nanometres.
units.verify: 以有限元素模型計算鏡坯在 150 點支撐、不同仰角下的面形，與上式的量級互相核對；在拋光廠以與望遠鏡相同佈局的 150 點測試支撐量面形，再到望遠鏡上以波前感測器量重力變形殘差，三者一致才代表支撐模型可信。~Compute the blank's figure on 150 supports at several elevations with a finite-element model and cross-check the order of magnitude against the formula; measure the figure in the polishing shop on a 150-point test support matching the telescope layout, then measure the gravity residual on the telescope with the wavefront sensor; only when all three agree is the support model trustworthy.
units.failure: 若把薄鏡當成剛體，只用少數硬點支撐或夾持，鏡面在重力下產生毫米級變形與強烈像散，影像完全失焦；即使支撐點數足夠，只要某一區的力分配錯誤，該區就會留下數百 nm 的局部凹陷。~Treating the thin mirror as rigid and holding it on a few hard points or clamps produces millimetre-scale gravity deformation and severe astigmatism, defocusing the image entirely; even with enough supports, a wrong force allocation in one zone leaves a local depression of hundreds of nanometres there.
units.misconception: 主鏡越厚越好，薄鏡只是為了省錢而犧牲品質。~Thicker primaries are always better; thin mirrors merely trade quality for cost.

units.anchor: 彎曲模態與修正力分佈~Bending modes and correction-force patterns
units.title: 主動光學原理：模態剛性與低頻修正~Active-optics principle: modal stiffness and slow correction
units.mechanism: 主動光學以約每分鐘一次的節奏修正緩慢變化的像差，包括隨仰角改變的重力變形、溫度梯度、拋光殘差與支撐誤差，而不是修正大氣湍流。把鏡面變形展開成自由圓板的彎曲模態最有效率，因為每個模態有各自的剛性：像散與三葉形等低階模態最軟，只需小力就能修正，高階模態所需的力則隨階數迅速增加。因此主動光學只修前十到二十個模態，更高階的誤差必須在拋光階段就做好；VLT 另把離焦與彗差交給副鏡的位置修正。~Active optics corrects slowly varying aberrations at roughly one update per minute, including elevation-dependent gravity deformation, thermal gradients, polishing residuals and support errors, not atmospheric turbulence. Expanding the deformation in the bending modes of a free circular plate is most efficient because each mode has its own stiffness: low-order modes such as astigmatism and trefoil are softest and need little force, while the force needed rises steeply with mode order. Active optics therefore corrects only the first ten to twenty modes, higher orders must be polished out, and the VLT hands defocus and coma to secondary-mirror position control.
units.model: 自由圓板固有頻率 f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt))；以 ν ≈ 0.33 的特徵值 λ² ≈ 5.25（像散）、9.08（軸對稱）、12.2（三葉形）、21.6（四葉形）與 √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s 代入，得約 15、27、36、64 Hz。模態剛性 ∝ ω²，同振幅下三葉形所需力約為像散的 (12.2/5.25)² ≈ 5.4 倍、四葉形約 17 倍；若 ±120 N 力預算能修 1 µm 像散（教學假設），同樣力只修約 0.18 µm 三葉形或 0.06 µm 四葉形。~Free-plate natural frequencies are f = λ²/(2πa²)·√(D/(ρt)); with ν ≈ 0.33 eigenvalues λ² ≈ 5.25 (astigmatism), 9.08 (axisymmetric), 12.2 (trefoil) and 21.6 (quadrafoil) and √(D/(ρt)) ≈ 311 m²/s, they are about 15, 27, 36 and 64 Hz. Modal stiffness scales as ω², so at equal amplitude trefoil needs about (12.2/5.25)² ≈ 5.4 times the force of astigmatism and quadrafoil about 17 times; if a ±120 N budget corrects 1 µm of astigmatism (teaching assumption), the same force corrects only about 0.18 µm of trefoil or 0.06 µm of quadrafoil.
units.verify: 在鏡上逐一對單支致動器施加已知力變化，以干涉儀或波前感測器量其響應，建立影響函數矩陣；對矩陣做奇異值分解，確認奇異向量的形狀與彎曲模態相符、奇異值隨模態階數遞減，並依此決定要納入控制的模態數。~Apply a known force change to one actuator at a time and measure the response with an interferometer or the wavefront sensor to build the influence-function matrix; take its singular-value decomposition, confirm that the singular vectors resemble the bending modes and that singular values fall with mode order, and use this to decide how many modes enter the control.
units.failure: 若控制器試圖修正高階模態，所需的力會超出致動器範圍或讓少數致動器飽和，並把量測雜訊放大成局部力尖峰，鏡面反而出現新的高頻殘差；若把湍流當成修正對象而縮短積分時間，同樣會把大氣雜訊寫進鏡面。~If the controller tries to correct high-order modes, the required forces exceed actuator range or saturate a few actuators and amplify measurement noise into local force spikes, leaving new high-frequency residuals on the mirror; shortening integration to chase turbulence likewise writes atmospheric noise into the figure.
units.misconception: 主動光學和自適應光學一樣，可以即時修正大氣湍流。~Active optics, like adaptive optics, corrects atmospheric turbulence in real time.

units.anchor: 150 支軸向致動器與荷重元~150 axial actuators and load cells
units.title: 軸向支撐：力分配、仰角載重與力精度~Axial support: force distribution, elevation load and force accuracy
units.mechanism: VLT 主鏡由 150 支電腦控制的軸向力致動器支撐，每支透過三腳架與 invar 墊（共 450 個）把力分散到鏡背，避免點載重在鏡面留下印痕。致動器同時承擔被動重量並疊加主動修正力，所以設計重點是力控制而非位置控制：鏡子的剛體位置由少數定義點或分區的被動系統決定，其餘致動器負責在該位置下提供正確的力分佈。仰角改變時軸向分量按 cos z 減少，力設定點必須連續追隨。~The VLT primary rests on 150 computer-controlled axial force actuators, each spreading its load through a tripod and invar pads, 450 in total, so that point loads do not print through to the surface. The actuators carry the passive weight and add active correction forces on top, so the design emphasises force control rather than position control: the mirror's rigid-body position is fixed by a few defining points or passive zoned systems, and the remaining actuators supply the correct force distribution at that position. As elevation changes the axial component falls as cos z, and the force set points must follow continuously.
units.model: 鏡重 23.0 t，W ≈ 226 kN，天頂時平均每支 1,506 N；天頂角 30° 時軸向總載 196 kN（每支 1,305 N）、側向 113 kN；60° 時軸向 113 kN（每支 753 N）、側向 196 kN。ESO 為拋光殘差保留約 ±120 N 主動力，約為天頂被動載重的 8%；若要把力設定誤差壓在主動預算的 1% 以內，每支力精度需約 1 N 或更好。~With a 23.0 t mirror, W ≈ 226 kN, an average of 1,506 N per actuator at zenith; at 30° zenith angle the axial load is 196 kN (1,305 N each) and the lateral load 113 kN; at 60° the axial load is 113 kN (753 N each) and the lateral 196 kN. ESO reserves about ±120 N of active force for figuring errors, about 8% of the zenith passive load; keeping set-point errors within 1% of that active budget requires about 1 N force accuracy per actuator or better.
units.verify: 每支致動器出廠前以標準荷重元校正力對指令的曲線與遲滯；安裝後做力總和檢查：各支量測力的總和扣除定義點分擔後必須等於 W·cos z，在多個仰角下記錄偏差，並長期追蹤每支的力值與模型預測之差。~Before delivery calibrate each actuator's force-versus-command curve and hysteresis against a reference load cell; after installation perform force-sum checks in which the measured forces minus the share of the defining points must equal W·cos z, log the deviation at several elevations, and track each actuator's difference from the model over the long term.
units.failure: 某支致動器的荷重元零點漂移 20 N 而未被發現，控制器以為力正確，鏡面在該處留下局部凸起，影像外圍出現不對稱光暈；若力總和與定義點載重持續偏離，代表有機械卡滯或定義點過載。~A load-cell zero drift of 20 N on one actuator goes unnoticed, the controller believes the force is correct, and the mirror develops a local bump there that shows up as an asymmetric halo around images; a persistent mismatch between the force sum and the defining-point loads signals mechanical sticking or an overloaded defining point.
units.misconception: 主鏡致動器只要把位置控制到奈米級，力的大小無關緊要。~Primary-mirror actuators need only nanometre position control; force does not matter.

units.anchor: 側向支撐與鏡室熱環境~Lateral supports and cell thermal environment
units.title: 側向支撐、溫度梯度與鏡面熱慣性~Lateral support, thermal gradients and mirror thermal inertia
units.mechanism: 望遠鏡傾斜時，鏡重的 sin z 分量由黏在鏡緣的側向支撐墊承擔；側向力若不通過鏡子的質心平面就會產生彎矩，把像散壓進鏡面，因此側向支撐的位置與力分配必須與軸向力修正搭配設計。溫度則有兩種效應：穿過厚度的溫度梯度使鏡面整體彎曲，主要表現為離焦；Zerodur 熱膨脹係數的不均勻則在整體溫變下產生高階變形。此外鏡面比夜間空氣暖時會在表面形成湍流邊界層，所以白天要把鏡子預冷到預期的夜間溫度。~When the telescope tilts, the sin z component of the weight is carried by lateral pads bonded to the mirror edge; lateral forces that do not act through the plane of the centre of mass create bending moments that press astigmatism into the surface, so lateral-support placement and force sharing must be designed together with axial corrections. Temperature acts in two ways: a gradient through the thickness bends the whole mirror, mainly as defocus, while inhomogeneity of the Zerodur expansion coefficient produces higher-order deformation under uniform temperature change. A mirror warmer than the night air also grows a turbulent boundary layer above its surface, so it is pre-cooled during the day to the expected night temperature.
units.model: 穿厚度溫差 ΔT = 0.5 K、CTE α = 0.05 ppm/K、t = 0.175 m：曲率 κ = α·ΔT/t ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹，在半徑 4.1 m 的矢高變化 κa²/2 ≈ 1.2 µm，幾乎全是離焦，可由副鏡修正。熱時間常數 τ ≈ ρ·c·t/h：c = 821 J/(kg·K)、自然對流 h ≈ 5 W/(m²·K) 時 τ ≈ 20 h，強制通風 h ≈ 15 W/(m²·K) 時約 6.7 h，鏡溫跟不上一夜的氣溫下降。~A through-thickness difference ΔT = 0.5 K with CTE α = 0.05 ppm/K and t = 0.175 m gives curvature κ = α·ΔT/t ≈ 1.4×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ and a sag change κa²/2 ≈ 1.2 µm at 4.1 m radius, almost pure defocus that the secondary can correct. The thermal time constant τ ≈ ρ·c·t/h with c = 821 J/(kg·K) is about 20 h for natural convection h ≈ 5 W/(m²·K) and about 6.7 h with forced ventilation h ≈ 15 W/(m²·K), so the mirror cannot follow the night-time air-temperature fall.
units.verify: 在鏡背與鏡面附近佈設溫度感測器，記錄鏡體與圓頂空氣的溫差及穿厚度梯度，並與主動光學量到的離焦與高階模態係數對時間作相關；側向支撐則在不同天頂角比較像散係數，確認其隨 sin z 的變化已被軸向力表格抵消。~Install temperature sensors at the back and near the face of the mirror, log the mirror-to-dome-air difference and the through-thickness gradient, and correlate them in time with the defocus and higher-order mode coefficients from active optics; for lateral support compare astigmatism coefficients at several zenith angles and confirm that their sin z dependence is cancelled by the axial force tables.
units.failure: 預冷不足時鏡面比空氣暖 2 到 3 K，整夜出現隨時間緩慢改善的鏡面視寧度，影像變寬卻被誤判為大氣條件差；側向支撐力分配錯誤時，像散係數隨天頂角系統性變化，主動光學每次換目標都在追同一個誤差。~With inadequate pre-cooling the mirror runs 2 to 3 K warmer than the air, producing mirror seeing that slowly improves through the night and broadens images that are then blamed on the atmosphere; with mis-shared lateral forces astigmatism varies systematically with zenith angle and active optics chases the same error after every slew.
units.misconception: 使用低膨脹的 Zerodur 後，主鏡就不需要任何熱控制。~With low-expansion Zerodur the primary needs no thermal control at all.

units.anchor: Shack–Hartmann 主動光學感測器~Active-optics Shack–Hartmann sensor
units.title: 波前感測：積分時間、視寧度平均與模態估計~Wavefront sensing: integration time, seeing averaging and modal estimation
units.mechanism: 主動光學的波前感測器裝在導引探頭中，以視場邊緣的一顆星做 Shack–Hartmann 量測：微透鏡陣列把瞳面切成子孔徑，每個光點的位移正比於該處的局部波前斜率。因為要量的是鏡面而不是大氣，曝光必須長到把湍流造成的光點隨機抖動平均掉，VLT 以約 30 秒積分、約每分鐘修正一次。量到的斜率再以最小平方法投影到主鏡彎曲模態與副鏡的離焦、彗差，換算成力與位置修正量。~The active-optics wavefront sensor sits in the guide probe and makes a Shack–Hartmann measurement on a star at the edge of the field: a lenslet array divides the pupil into subapertures, and each spot's displacement is proportional to the local wavefront slope. Because the target is the mirror and not the atmosphere, exposures must be long enough to average out turbulence-induced spot jitter, so the VLT integrates for about 30 s and corrects roughly once a minute. The measured slopes are projected by least squares onto the primary's bending modes and the secondary's defocus and coma, then converted into force and position corrections.
units.model: 假設 20×20 子孔徑，d = 8.2/20 = 0.41 m，r₀ = 0.15 m（500 nm）：單軸傾斜方差 σ² ≈ 0.17(λ/d)²(d/r₀)^(5/3)，σ ≈ 1.16 µrad ≈ 0.24″。風速 10 m/s 時子孔徑傾斜相關時間約 d/v ≈ 0.041 s，30 s 內約 730 個獨立樣本，平均後 σ ≈ 0.24/√730 ≈ 0.009″，乘以 d 約為 18 nm 的子孔徑波前傾斜。~Assume 20×20 subapertures, d = 8.2/20 = 0.41 m and r₀ = 0.15 m at 500 nm: the one-axis tilt variance σ² ≈ 0.17(λ/d)²(d/r₀)^(5/3) gives σ ≈ 1.16 µrad ≈ 0.24″. With a 10 m/s wind the subaperture tilt correlation time is about d/v ≈ 0.041 s, giving about 730 independent samples in 30 s, so averaging leaves σ ≈ 0.24/√730 ≈ 0.009″, about 18 nm of wavefront tilt across a subaperture.
units.verify: 先以內部參考光源校正感測器零點，也就是每個光點的參考位置；再對同一顆星以不同積分時間重複量測，畫模態係數的標準差對積分時間的曲線，應按 1/√T 下降直到量測雜訊底；並以已知的副鏡離焦偏移檢查重建係數的增益是否為 1。~First calibrate the sensor zero point, the reference position of every spot, with an internal reference source; then repeat measurements on one star at several integration times and plot the standard deviation of mode coefficients versus integration time, which should fall as 1/√T down to the measurement-noise floor; finally inject a known secondary-mirror defocus offset to check that the reconstruction gain is unity.
units.failure: 若積分只有幾秒，殘留的大氣像差被當成鏡面誤差送進致動器，主鏡每次修正都在追隨機雜訊，面形越修越差；參考零點若隨溫度漂移，則會穩定地把一個不存在的像差寫進鏡面。~With only a few seconds of integration, residual atmospheric aberration is mistaken for mirror error and sent to the actuators, so each correction chases random noise and the figure degrades; a reference zero point that drifts with temperature steadily writes a non-existent aberration into the mirror.
units.misconception: 主動光學感測器量得越快越好，曝光一秒就足夠。~Faster is always better for the active-optics sensor; one-second exposures suffice.

units.anchor: 影響矩陣與誤差預算表~Influence matrix and error-budget table
units.title: 校正矩陣、模態截斷與面形誤差預算~Calibration matrix, modal truncation and the figure-error budget
units.mechanism: 主動光學的核心校正是影響矩陣，也就是每一支致動器或每一組模態力分佈對波前感測量測值的響應。控制器用矩陣的擬反把量到的模態係數轉成力修正，並截斷奇異值太小的模態，以免把雜訊放大。修正後的殘差要進入誤差預算：拋光殘差、支撐印痕、主動光學殘差、熱變形與風載各項以均方根相加，再換算成不同波長的 Strehl 或影像寬度，才能判斷主鏡是否滿足儀器需求。~The central calibration of active optics is the influence matrix, the response of the wavefront-sensor measurements to each actuator or each modal force pattern. The controller uses its pseudo-inverse to turn measured mode coefficients into force corrections, truncating modes with small singular values so that noise is not amplified. The corrected residual then enters the error budget: polishing residual, support print-through, active-optics residual, thermal deformation and wind load are added root-sum-square and converted into Strehl or image width at several wavelengths to judge whether the primary meets instrument needs.
units.model: 波前 RMS 預算（教學假設）：拋光 30 nm、支撐印痕 15 nm、主動光學殘差 25 nm、熱 20 nm、風載 15 nm，RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm。Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²]：2.2 µm 約 0.98、1.0 µm 約 0.91、0.5 µm 約 0.69，表示此主鏡在近紅外自適應光學下幾乎不扣分，在可見光則已消耗可觀預算。~Wavefront RMS budget (teaching assumption): polishing 30 nm, support print-through 15 nm, active-optics residual 25 nm, thermal 20 nm and wind 15 nm give RSS = √(30² + 15² + 25² + 20² + 15²) ≈ 49 nm. Strehl ≈ exp[−(2πσ/λ)²] is about 0.98 at 2.2 µm, 0.91 at 1.0 µm and 0.69 at 0.5 µm, so this primary costs almost nothing behind near-infrared adaptive optics but consumes a sizeable budget in the visible.
units.verify: 逐一施加已知振幅的單一模態，量測回推振幅，驗證矩陣增益與交叉耦合（應小於 5%）；開閉迴路交替並記錄每次修正後的殘差模態係數，取長期統計填入預算表，與設計值逐項比較，任何一項超出時追查來源。~Apply single modes of known amplitude one at a time and measure the recovered amplitude to verify matrix gain and cross-coupling, which should stay below 5%; alternate open and closed loop, log the residual mode coefficients after every correction, enter long-term statistics in the budget table, compare item by item with the design, and trace the source of any item that exceeds its allocation.
units.failure: 影響矩陣在拋光廠支撐上量得卻直接用在望遠鏡支撐上，兩者邊界條件不同，修正某模態時同時激發另一模態，迴路收斂變慢甚至在兩個模態之間振盪；預算表若混用表面誤差與波前誤差，反射加倍效應會讓影響被低估一半。~An influence matrix measured on the polishing-shop support but applied on the telescope support has different boundary conditions, so correcting one mode excites another, convergence slows, or the loop oscillates between two modes; a budget that mixes surface and wavefront errors underestimates the impact by half because reflection doubles surface error.
units.misconception: 致動器越多、修正的模態越多，殘差就一定越小。~More actuators and more corrected modes always mean smaller residuals.

units.anchor: 仰角查找表與副鏡六軸平台~Elevation look-up table and M2 hexapod
units.title: 開迴路查找表、閉迴路修正與主副鏡分工~Open-loop tables, closed-loop correction and M1–M2 division of labour
units.mechanism: 每次換目標都沒有時間從零收斂，所以主動光學以開迴路查找表為基礎：依鏡筒仰角與溫度預測主鏡力分佈與副鏡位置，再用閉迴路量測逐步修正殘差。主鏡負責像散、三葉形、球差等彎曲模態，副鏡以位置移動修正離焦與彗差，兩者共用同一組感測資料但頻寬不同；VLT 另有最高約 1 Hz 的快速修正，只處理最低階項。查找表的品質決定了換目標後多久才能開始科學曝光。~There is no time to converge from scratch after every slew, so active optics starts from open-loop look-up tables that predict primary forces and secondary position from tube elevation and temperature, and then trims the residual with closed-loop measurements. The primary handles bending modes such as astigmatism, trefoil and spherical aberration, while the secondary corrects defocus and coma by moving, both sharing the same sensor data at different bandwidths; the VLT also runs fast corrections up to about 1 Hz for the lowest-order terms only. Table quality decides how soon after a slew science exposures can start.
units.model: 迴路增益 g = 0.3、每次修正間隔 45 s：殘差 e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀。初始誤差 500 nm、目標 30 nm 時 n = ln(30/500)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.9，需 8 次約 6 分鐘；若查找表把初始誤差降到 100 nm，只需 ln(0.3)/ln(0.7) ≈ 3.4，即 4 次約 3 分鐘；把增益提高到 0.5 雖可減到 5 次，卻對量測雜訊更敏感。~With loop gain g = 0.3 and 45 s between corrections, the residual follows e_n = (1 − g)ⁿ·e₀. From 500 nm down to 30 nm, n = ln(30/500)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.9, so 8 corrections or about 6 minutes; if the tables cut the initial error to 100 nm, only ln(0.3)/ln(0.7) ≈ 3.4, so 4 corrections or about 3 minutes; raising the gain to 0.5 shortens this to 5 corrections but makes the loop more sensitive to measurement noise.
units.verify: 在多個仰角與溫度下記錄閉迴路收斂後的力分佈與副鏡位置，擬合成仰角與溫度的函數以更新查找表；換目標後記錄前幾次修正的殘差序列，與 (1 − g)ⁿ 模型比較，確認收斂率與設定增益一致且沒有過衝。~Record the converged closed-loop force distribution and secondary position at many elevations and temperatures and fit them as functions of elevation and temperature to update the tables; after each slew log the residual sequence of the first few corrections and compare it with the (1 − g)ⁿ model to confirm that the convergence rate matches the set gain without overshoot.
units.failure: 更換致動器或重新鍍膜後未更新查找表，每次換目標都從大誤差開始，前幾分鐘的影像品質不合格；若主鏡與副鏡同時修正彗差而沒有明確分工，兩者會互相抵消並緩慢漂移，最後讓副鏡偏心超出行程。~Failing to update the tables after an actuator exchange or recoating means every slew starts from a large error and the first minutes of data fail image-quality limits; if primary and secondary both correct coma without a clear division, they cancel each other and drift slowly until the secondary decentre runs out of range.
units.misconception: 只要有閉迴路修正，開迴路查找表就沒有用處。~With closed-loop correction available, open-loop look-up tables are useless.

units.anchor: 影像品質驗收與力圖監測~Image-quality acceptance and force-map monitoring
units.title: 整合驗證、力圖監測與工程交接~Integrated validation, force-map monitoring and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 主動支撐的驗收必須在望遠鏡上完成：在各仰角與溫度條件下量閉迴路後的模態殘差與影像寬度，把主鏡對總影像品質的貢獻從大氣、導星與儀器中分離出來。運轉後，力圖是主鏡健康最直接的紀錄：每支致動器的力歷史、力總和與重量的一致性、主動力是否逐漸逼近極限，都能提前揭露卡滯、荷重元漂移或支撐墊脫膠。交接文件需包含影響矩陣版本、查找表、各致動器校正係數與安全限值。~Acceptance of active support must happen on the telescope: measure closed-loop mode residuals and image width over elevation and temperature, separating the primary's contribution to total image quality from atmosphere, guide star and instrument. In operation the force map is the most direct record of mirror health: each actuator's force history, the agreement of the force sum with the weight, and whether active forces creep towards their limits all reveal sticking, load-cell drift or debonding pads early. The handoff file must hold the influence-matrix version, look-up tables, per-actuator calibration coefficients and safety limits.
units.model: 力總和檢查：W = 226 kN，天頂角 30° 時軸向應為 W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN；若允許 0.5% 偏差，相當於 ±0.98 kN，超出即告警。主動力趨勢：若某支致動器的主動力每月增加 3 N、距 ±120 N 預算還剩 60 N，約 20 個月後耗盡，必須排入下一次維護窗口。~Force-sum check: with W = 226 kN, the axial sum at 30° zenith angle should be W·cos 30° ≈ 195.7 kN; a 0.5% tolerance equals ±0.98 kN, beyond which an alarm is raised. Active-force trend: if one actuator's active force grows by 3 N per month with 60 N left before the ±120 N budget, it runs out in about 20 months and must be scheduled for the next maintenance window.
units.verify: 以天頂角 0°、30°、60° 的夜間測試記錄模態殘差、影像半高全寬與力總和，並與交接文件中的基準比對；每週自動產生力圖報告，列出偏離模型超過門檻的致動器與其趨勢，維護後重新量測影響函數確認修復。~Run night tests at 0°, 30° and 60° zenith angle recording mode residuals, image FWHM and force sums, and compare them with the baselines in the handoff file; generate a weekly force-map report listing actuators whose deviation from the model exceeds threshold together with their trends, and re-measure influence functions after maintenance to confirm the repair.
units.failure: 某個側向支撐墊的黏膠逐漸失效，鏡子在高天頂角時微小位移並產生像散，主動光學以越來越大的力補償，影像品質表面上仍合格；直到力達極限才突然無法修正，若沒有趨勢監測，失效會在觀測夜中才被發現。~The adhesive on one lateral pad slowly fails, the mirror shifts slightly at large zenith angles and develops astigmatism, and active optics compensates with ever larger forces while image quality still passes; only when forces hit their limits does correction suddenly fail, and without trend monitoring the fault appears in the middle of an observing night.
units.misconception: 只要影像品質合格，主鏡支撐系統就一定健康。~If image quality passes, the primary support system must be healthy.

example: 主動修正練習：假設一面 8.2 m、175 mm 厚的 Zerodur 薄鏡位於天頂角 45°。鏡重 226 kN，軸向分量 226 × cos 45° ≈ 160 kN，150 支平均每支約 1,065 N，側向同為約 160 kN。夜間鏡體穿厚度溫差 0.4 K、α = 0.05 ppm/K：κ = 0.05×10⁻⁶ × 0.4/0.175 ≈ 1.14×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹，矢高 κa²/2 = 1.14×10⁻⁷ × 4.1²/2 ≈ 0.96 µm，交給副鏡以離焦修正。感測器量得像散係數 600 nm，主鏡迴路增益 0.3、每 45 s 修正一次，要降到 40 nm 需 n = ln(40/600)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.6，即 8 次、約 6 分鐘。殘差預算為拋光 30、印痕 15、主動 25、熱 20、風 15 nm，RSS ≈ 49 nm，在 1.0 µm 的 Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 49/1000)²] ≈ 0.91。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Active-correction exercise: assume an 8.2 m, 175 mm thick Zerodur meniscus at 45° zenith angle. The 226 kN weight has an axial component of 226 × cos 45° ≈ 160 kN, about 1,065 N on average for each of 150 actuators, and a lateral component of about 160 kN as well. At night a 0.4 K through-thickness difference with α = 0.05 ppm/K gives κ = 0.05×10⁻⁶ × 0.4/0.175 ≈ 1.14×10⁻⁷ m⁻¹ and a sag of κa²/2 = 1.14×10⁻⁷ × 4.1²/2 ≈ 0.96 µm, which the secondary removes as defocus. The sensor reports 600 nm of astigmatism; with gain 0.3 and one correction every 45 s, reaching 40 nm needs n = ln(40/600)/ln(0.7) ≈ 7.6, so 8 corrections or about 6 minutes. A residual budget of polishing 30, print-through 15, active 25, thermal 20 and wind 15 nm gives RSS ≈ 49 nm and Strehl ≈ exp[−(2π × 49/1000)²] ≈ 0.91 at 1.0 µm. Values are teaching assumptions, not any telescope's specification.
history: 主動光學由 ESO 的 Raymond Wilson 在 1970 至 1980 年代系統化提出，1989 年拉西亞的 3.58 m 新技術望遠鏡（NTT）成為第一座以主動光學運轉的大型望遠鏡，證明薄而軟的主鏡可以由電腦控制的支撐力保持面形。1998 年起 VLT 的四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡沿用此概念，Gemini 與 Subaru 的 8 m 級彎月鏡也各自採用主動支撐，使 8 m 級單片主鏡成為可行。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~Active optics was systematised by Raymond Wilson at ESO during the 1970s and 1980s, and in 1989 the 3.58 m New Technology Telescope (NTT) at La Silla became the first large telescope operated with active optics, proving that a thin, flexible primary can hold its figure through computer-controlled support forces. From 1998 the four 8.2 m VLT Unit Telescopes adopted the concept, and the 8 m class menisci of Gemini and Subaru also use active support, making monolithic 8 m primaries feasible. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
